C0583.title: Douyin Store Dropshipping Guide: Key Rules for Category Mismatch Violations
C0583.summary: The article explains that in the Douyin store dropshipping model, category mismatch refers to listing products under incorrect categories, such as placing personal care items under automotive supplies. Such violations lead to product bans, a 500-yuan deduction from the deposit per incident, and store removal in severe cases.
